name: Asakura Yuusuke
source:
St. Ao Academy 2nd year high school student. B class.

The protagonist's childhood friend who moved to her town seven years ago.
He lives in a neighboring apartment to the protagonist with his parents.
He's a little unreliable, but when it's important he can act pretty manly, though he's always fighting with the protagonist.
